instruction: I have computed the acceleration in row 2, and I want you to copy this formula down to fill out all other rows for columns B and D. Then identify the maximum acceleration value in column D and enter it in cell D31.

metadata.explanation: Task requires copying formulas from B2 and D2 down to rows 3-30, then finding the maximum value in column D and entering it in D31. Evaluator checks if cell D31 contains the correct maximum value. Verified with Python: max of D2:D30 = 1.213797 (occurs at row 30, user enters in D31).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if max value matches and location is D31, 0.5 if only value matches, 0.0 otherwise
